correctness.rationale: Using the actual lattice form F²=0, O²=-2, F.O=1, G²=-4, direct reconstruction gives p_a(aF+3O+cG)=3a-8-2c² and S_w=2w²F+O+wG has S_w²=-2, F.S_w=1. Riemann–Roch and absence of vertical (-2) components yield actual irreducible section S_w. For all degree-three irreducible C, C.S_w=(p_a(C)-10)/3+6(w-c/3)²>=0; an integer w at distance <=1/3 proves p_a>=8. D=6F+3O+G has D²=14 and D.F=3; nefness follows from vertical curves, the positive cone for nonnegative-square curves, and the root identity v(D.Gamma)=3v²+6w²-3-4vw>=0. There is no isotropic E with D.E=1, excluding the relevant Saint-Donat basepoint obstruction. Bertini on basepoint-free |D| gives a smooth genus-eight member. Independently re-multiplied the exact form, section squares and D products; no inference from finite tests.
residual_risks: Scope restricted to full rank-three Néron–Severi lattice; specializations with extra curves are excluded. The basepoint-free theorem is a standard external geometric input, not re-proved.
